entities.name: Query ThiI protein
observations: 484 aa soluble bacterial protein; predicted molecular weight 53.997 kDa and pI 6.42.
Shares 80.1% identity over 99.8% of its length with reviewed Marinobacter nauticus ThiI (UniProt A1U6U9).
Contains Pfam ThiI_fer at residues 3–76, THUMP at 87–163, and ThiI catalytic domain at 176–368.
C-terminal region contains the conserved rhodanese sulfur-transfer domain; the active-site persulfide cysteine is expected near residue 456 by homologous feature mapping.
No transmembrane or secretion signal is indicated by the sequence analysis; homologs are cytoplasmic.

entities.name: ThiI tRNA sulfurtransferase
observations: EC 2.8.1.4 enzyme that catalyzes ATP-dependent sulfur transfer to tRNA uridine-8, producing 4-thiouridine.
Also sulfurylates the ThiS sulfur carrier protein, contributing to thiazole formation in thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis.
Uses sulfur supplied as a persulfide from a cysteine desulfurase such as IscS.
Reviewed homolog annotations place the enzyme in the cytoplasm and associate it with ATP binding, tRNA binding, tRNA 4-thiouridine biosynthesis, and thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: tRNA 4-thiouridine biosynthesis
observations: ThiI installs sulfur at position 4 of uridine-8 in tRNA; 4-thiouridine can function as a near-UV photosensory/photoregulatory modification.

entities.name: Thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis
observations: ThiI-mediated ThiS thiocarboxylate formation contributes to thiazole synthesis in the thiamine diphosphate biosynthetic pathway.
